title: Moving Standard Deviation
text: Moving standard deviation, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Method} sets the moving standard deviation method Sliding, {Specify window length} sets the flag to specify window length, {Window length} sets the length of sliding window, {Overlap length}, {Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals}, {Specify forgetting factor from input port} sets the flag to specify forgetting factor, {Forgetting factor} sets the exponential weighting factor and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: lambda
ports.summary: Forgetting factor non-negative real scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Moving standard deviation output vector | matrix

params.name: Method
params.values: Moving standard deviation method Sliding window (default) | Exponential weighting

params.name: Specify window length
params.values: Flag to specify window length on (default) | off

params.name: Window length
params.values: Length of sliding window 4 (default) | positive scalar integer

params.name: Overlap length
params.values: Overlap length between windows 3 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals off (default) | on

params.name: Specify forgetting factor from input port
params.values: Flag to specify forgetting factor off (default) | on

params.name: Forgetting factor
params.values: Exponential weighting factor 0.9 (default) | non-negative real scalar in the range [0,1]

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
